content_blocks.text: Activities at this commercial stage include (not an exhaustive list):
developing a commercial strategy to define objectives and outcomes that align with departmental and government strategies and commercial policy
developing a category strategy to define how to plan, manage and optimise the procurement of specific goods or services
agreeing governance, risk management and allocation - including managing and planning for commercial capability, capacity and resource.
